applies_to: every grammar candidate submitted, unchanged between candidates
purpose: Attack the grammar: decide quantitatively whether it merely re-skins the four legacy mutation buttons (APPEND_MUTATION, PRE_TRANSFORM, CONTROL_WRAP, BRANCH_ROUTE), and whether its cheap region is rich enough to host non-human-taxonomy change.

enumeration.order: shortlex over the grammar's frozen token order; lengths 1..L
enumeration.validity: abstract typing from initial type stack [B] with final type stack exactly [B]; runtime caps then apply during probe execution
enumeration.rank: index in shortlex enumeration restricted to typed-valid programs that execute without error on all structural probes
enumeration.exactness: full enumeration; all counts exact; all gates deterministic

probes.rationale: empty probe pins constant payloads; equal-length content-differing probes (P1 vs P2) expose content sensitivity; o4 present so control-token handling is exercised

fingerprints.structural: tuple of canonical serializations of the single output Block per structural probe
fingerprints.semantic: per structural probe, the output artifact executed on each semantic probe stack; result is final stack or error code; semantic fingerprint is the full tuple

categories.noop: semantically equal to input on all (probe, stack) pairs but structurally changed on at least one probe
categories.destructive: every (probe, stack) execution of every output errors

edit_shapes.mixed_definition: class 'other' AND at least two of {introduces_tokens, removes_tokens, reorders}

legacy4.route_like: flag introduces_control (object conditional token newly present in output)

edit_shapes.note: shape classification is offline human audit only; never learner-visible (spec section 25)

CK1_single_token_button.rule: KILL if any single grammar token, run as a complete transform, realizes a legacy4 family
CK1_single_token_button.rationale: a one-token legacy family is literally a vending-machine button with a new label

CK2_cheap_region_share.rule: KILL if legacy4 behaviors (union) exceed 60% of the first 200 behaviorally distinct, non-identity, non-constant transforms in canonical rank order
CK2_cheap_region_share.rationale: payload variety makes legacy families numerous in ANY concatenative editor; the kill is for a cheap region that is ESSENTIALLY ONLY the old buttons. 60% chosen so that a majority-legacy head with a substantial non-legacy minority survives, but a button-dominated head dies

CK3_shape_diversity_of_cheap_region.rule: KILL if the first 200 distinct behaviors contain fewer than 12 distinct collapsed edit shapes, or fewer than 2 non-legacy shapes per legacy shape present
CK3_shape_diversity_of_cheap_region.rationale: the cheap region must be a continuum of edit shapes in which the old buttons are unremarkable points

CK4_relative_cheapness.rule: KILL if any legacy4 family's minimal realizing program length <= (median minimal length over all reachable collapsed shapes) - 2
CK4_relative_cheapness.rationale: grammar-relative version of 'trivial low-rank basin': legacy categories must not be systematically cheaper than typical categories

CK5_reachability.rule: KILL if any of {append, prepend, wrap, insert, take-or-dropfx-or-delete, selfcat, perm, route_like, mixed} is unreachable at the horizon
CK5_reachability.rationale: a grammar that cannot express a family is not avoiding leakage, it is avoiding the hypothesis; mixed-pathology worlds will demand mixed edits

CK6_diversity_floors.rule: KILL if structurally distinct behaviors < 3% of valid programs at horizon, or total structurally distinct < 500, or semantically distinct < 300
CK6_diversity_floors.rationale: below these floors the space is mostly syntactic duplication and search has nothing to select among; structural counts are an upper bound on semantic diversity, so the semantic floor is the binding one

CK7_mixed_density.rule: KILL if mixed-shape behaviors < 1% of all distinct non-identity behaviors at horizon
CK7_mixed_density.rationale: the experiment's target phenotypes are mixed; they must be reachable at more than trace density

CK8_world_target_template.rule: DEFERRED to world census: KILL the world (not the grammar) if its target is solvable by a <=3-token template from any single legacy family
CK8_world_target_template.rationale: requires worlds; recorded here so it cannot be quietly dropped

reporting_requirements: attainable ranges reported beside every gate so eligibility-to-fire is visible (a gate that cannot fire is not a gate)
per-length distinct-behavior counts and per-shape first-occurrence ranks
rejected grammars preserved with full census output in rejected_grammars.jsonl
